title: Multi-Faceted Interactivity Alignment in Full-Duplex Speech Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.11167v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models can listen and speak simultaneously, making them a promising architecture for natural conversation. However, current models are trained solely with supervised learning through token-level likelihood maximization, which does not directly optimize interaction-level behaviors, causing interactivity issues such as excessive silence and ill-timed turn-taking. Recent work has applied reinforcement learning (RL) to improve interactivity, but existing methods address only a limited set of interactive behaviors in their rewards. In this work, we propose a post-training alignment method that comprehensively improves the interactivity of full-duplex spoken dialogue models through RL. We address the four canonical axes of interactivity: pause handling, turn-taking, backchanneling, and user interruption. translated_title: 全双工语音模型中的多层面交互性对齐
translated_abstract: 全双工口语对话模型可以同时聆听和说话，使其成为一种有前景的自然对话架构。然而，当前模型仅通过基于标记级似然最大化的监督学习进行训练，这种方式并未直接优化交互层面的行为，从而导致过度沉默、话轮转换时机不当等交互性问题。近期工作已将强化学习（RL）应用于改善交互性，但现有方法在奖励设计中仅覆盖了有限的交互行为集合。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种后训练对齐方法，通过强化学习全面改善全双工口语对话模型的交互性。我们针对交互性的四个经典维度：停顿处理、话轮转换、附和反馈和用户打断。对于每个维度，我们从人类对话语料库中提取短音频片段，并利用针对该维度的奖励对模型进行优化（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出一种基于强化学习的后训练对齐方法，从停顿处理、话轮转换、附和反馈和用户打断四个经典交互维度全面优化全双工口语对话模型的交互性。
en_tdlr: Proposes an RL-based post-training alignment method that comprehensively improves the interactivity of full-duplex spoken dialogue models across four canonical axes: pause handling, turn-taking, backchanneling, and user interruption.
